text:
sam_m: Heads-up from ops: intermittent API errors started ~09:30 PT in US-west. We need a very short public status and a separate enterprise email cadence.

hana_pd: Short public only for now. No social posts. Keep wording plain and empathetic.

kevin_ops: Root cause looks like a cache invalidation bug causing 502s for some endpoints. Working a patch, ETA ~75 minutes if tests go green.

elaine_cs: I'll pull a list of potentially impacted paid customers and prep CS notes. For the enterprise email, include mitigation tips and how to reach engineers directly.

status-bot: Suggested status copy:
```
We are investigating intermittent API errors affecting a subset of requests in US-west. Our engineers are working on a fix; we expect updates within ~30 minutes. If you are affected, contact support: https://redwood.ai/support
```

sam_m: Edit to include in-app opt-in: add "Reply \"Priority\" to this thread for priority alerts." Also avoid estimated recovery times in the public notice unless ops confirms.

hana_pd: Final public status (publish now):
```
We are investigating intermittent API errors affecting a subset of requests in US-west. Engineers are working on a fix; updates in ~30 minutes. If your app is impacted, contact support: https://redwood.ai/support (Reply "Priority" to this thread for priority alerts.)
```

kevin_ops: Publishing now. Will post a technical follow-up in 30m with patch progress; if ETA extends past 2h we recommend credit language in the enterprise follow-up.

elaine_cs: Action items: publish status + in-app banner (kevin) ✅, compile impacted customer list and draft enterprise email (elaine) ⏳, hold social/blog until RCA.

sam_m: Thanks — keep updates short and avoid blame. I'll coordinate with legal if we need to surface credits.
